reference.inspection: Ownership and lifecycle facts only; independent Rust implementation

findings.problem: Restore required Phase::Playing and paused=true together. macOS inactive resume used the same impossible predicate. A restore before pause acknowledgement also failed. Native Windows polling watched the controls surface rather than the framed playback owner.
findings.resolution: One generation-scoped AutomaticPause policy handles observed pause and pending acknowledgements, consumes its ownership marker once and rejects replaced/stopped media. Windows polls its actual native host.
findings.before_fix: The first two policy regressions failed before changing the resume condition.

findings.problem: A recognition result could be applied after a paused seek before another capture completed. Re-enabling could analyze an old frame while the new capture was pending. Full RGBA frames were copied every polling tick before checking whether another recognition job was needed.
findings.resolution: Serialize capture requests, wait for a new capture revision, discard superseded captures, clear old regions when frame identity changes and validate generation, position, seek revision and capture revision on completion. Copy pixels only when starting a new recognition job. The native worker acknowledges rejected, failed and successful capture requests, so serial capture can retry after failure.
findings.native_regression: live_text_capture_returns_a_tightly_packed_frame_only_while_paused now verifies rejected, successful and audio-only failed captures settle their requests

findings.problem: An open settings panel bypassed every timer guard, including disabled auto-hide, unloaded media, active dialogs, crop editing and dragging.
findings.resolution: A panel overrides stale native hover only; the remaining visibility guards still apply.

findings.problem: A late scan unconditionally stored its generation and could replace a newer completed scan, blocking automatic online subtitle search. Settings changes within the same file had no completion identity, and disabling/re-enabling retained a stale discovery signature.
findings.resolution: Readiness belongs to a generation and request sequence. Superseded completions are ignored, pending results are checked against the current request, and disable/re-enable requests a fresh scan.
